author: KEXP
description: Scaling dense walls of shoegaze and grit-soaked rock, Portland's Blackwater Holylight reach intoxicating new heights on their latest release 'Not Here Not Gone.' Our latest in-studio session invites them in to share a performance of "Heavy, Why" and more.
title: Blackwater Holylight performs "Heavy, Why" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:
http://KEXP.ORG presents Blackwater Holylight performing live in the KEXP studio. Recorded March 1, 2026.

Songs:  
Fade 00:22
Heavy, Why? 06:05
Void To Be 10:14
Spades 15:22

Sunny Faris - Bass, Vocal
Mikayla Mayhew - Guitar
Eliese Dorsay - Drums
Katt Garrigan - Keyboard

Host: Jewel Loree
Audio Engineer: Kevin Suggs
Mastering Engineer: Kevin Suggs

Cameras: Jim Beckmann, Carlos Cruz, Leah Franks & Luke Knecht
